transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, my daughter recently left for basic training, and... I don't know, ever since then, I just feel like I come home to a dead house. I can’t seem to keep myself together. 

It's really starting to affect my work. I'm sitting there crying in my truck before my shifts even start. I do sheet metal work, and lately I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years. I keep snapping at the younger guys on the floor, too. And when I'm home, I’ve just stopped going out on the water or working on my sculpture. I just don’t see the point right now. I just can't seem to shake this.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about a month. She left four weeks ago, and... yeah, I've just been struggling like this ever since then.
Alongside feeling down, have you also been experiencing a lot of anxiety, nervousness, or worry?

Not really. I mean, I worry about her being away, sure, just like any parent would. But I wouldn't say I feel nervous or anxious. It's more just... this heavy, empty feeling. I just feel drained and sad all the time, not really on edge.
How has your sleep been over this past month?

It's been fine, honestly. I haven't really noticed any changes there. I mean... I still go to bed at my usual time and sleep through the night. So, yeah, my sleep is okay. It's really just getting through the day that's the hard part.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this past month?
No, my appetite is about the same. I haven't noticed any weight loss or gain or anything like that. I'm still eating normally.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you were dead?
No, nothing like that. I mean, I feel incredibly sad and empty, but I don't want to die. I haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or anything along those lines.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, or experiencing excessive feelings of guilt or worthlessness?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel guilty about anything, and I don't think I'm worthless. I mean, I feel really awful and empty right now, but it's not like I'm beating myself up or feeling down on who I am. It's just... everything else is just really hard to deal with.
